$comment: sf-view-board, standard simai.smart-component 1.4 (vocabulary 1.1.5): the board layout of the view set (kanban; owner decisions C298, C304). Study: ui-control control/research/2026-11-17-board-view. Drag and keys are sf-sortable's, the card is .sf-card, the card fields the Framework field renderers' cell output, menus SF.menu.open, the selection bar sf-bulk-actions where the pair has it.

x-history.consumer: Nothing to change for a host. The card's box and «⋯» stand on the title's first line (LV3-16: «⋯» was 6 px below it). RV4-11: the card is a grid of the box, the title and «⋯»; the fields stand under the title (the hidden box pushed the title 32 px right of the fields).

Nothing to change for a host. The board's own name reads «Канбан» (owner decision D2, 2026-11-21; it was «Доска»): its title and the region's name when the host gives no aria-label; sf-view-board and its attributes stay.
Nothing to change for a host. A board card at size 1 draws its title and fields at text step 1 (16 at normal density), as sf-view-cards does; they stayed at 14.
Nothing to change for a host. The rule fetches sf-bulk-actions (lazy, when the bar is first drawn) over the pair ui-b654460cad2a, which carries it; over an older pair the board's own bar stays.
Nothing to change. The board's column head buttons stand 8 apart (4 in a compact area), the gap of buttons of one group.
Nothing to change: sums-pending is now for a page that computes the sums after the cards; sf-view does not set it (the sums come with the cards, C304).

New: sums-pending holds the lane heads' sum line while the sums come in a request after the cards; setLaneTotals([{value, totals}]) takes them. Nothing to change for a host that answers sums with the cards.
New: sf-view layout="board" (or Larena's kanban) draws it; a host answers the lane window (lanes, per_lane) and settles moves.

size.summary: The rung of the lane heads, the cards and their controls.

title-field.summary: The record key a card's title reads (else title, name, id).

order-field.summary: The source's manual order field (describe().order_field). Without it a lane follows the view's sort (C304 (2)).

sort-active.summary: A sort is on in the view: manual reorder inside a lane is off (C304 (2)).

selectable.summary: Cards carry the selection box; Space marks a card.

creatable.summary: «+» in a lane head and «Новая запись» in the lane menu: the create event with the lane's value.

movable.summary: Moves are offered; false refuses each with «Нет права менять».

lanes.summary: The lane window the host answered (C304): the first per_lane records of every lane, each lane's total under the filter and its sums (C294), a cursor for «Показать ещё».

fields.summary: Field descriptors (sf-view's columns): the lane field's options give the lane order, labels and colours; the card fields are drawn by the Framework field renderers.

options.summary: layouts.board of simai.view-config/1: lane_field, lanes {order, hidden, collapsed}, empty_lanes show|hide, card_fields (up to four), totals (count, {sum: key}), limits {lane: n} (soft, C304 (3)), order sort|manual, per_lane (20), swimlane_field (reserved, C304 (4)).

moves.summary: The host's move rules: {<to>: {from: [...], reason}}; a lane that refuses dims with the reason while a card is held and is disabled in «Переместить в».

actions.summary: The host's actions on a selection, after «Переместить в…».

sums-pending.summary: The sum line of each lane head is held empty until setLaneTotals brings the sums: for a page that computes them after the cards. sf-view does not set it: the sums come with the cards (C304).

move.summary: A card moved (drag, keys, the card menu, the bulk bar): shown at once and pale until the host answers settleMove. Cancel to refuse at once.

open.summary: The card's title or «Открыть» in its menu (vocabulary open): the host opens the record card (sf-view-properties, C289).

create.summary: «+» in a lane: the host opens a new record with the lane's value.

more.summary: «Показать ещё» in a lane: the host answers appendLane with that lane's next records.

save.summary: A lane folded, unfolded or hidden: the board's options to keep in the view (layouts.board.lanes).

apply.summary: A host action chosen on the selection in the bulk bar.

settle-move.summary: The host's answer to a move: {answer: applied, record?} keeps it; refused or conflict ({reason, message}) puts the card back and says why.

append-lane.summary: The host's next records of one lane (the answer to more).

set-lane-totals.summary: The lanes' totals the host answered after the cards ([{value, totals}], sums per currency); cards and cursors stay.

relations.name: cl-sortable
$comment: Drag, long press, the drop line, the keyboard move and its announcements (C171).

relations.name: cl-badge
$comment: The lane's name, a tonal badge of its option's colour (C140); a choice value on a card.

relations.name: cl-bulk-actions
$comment: The group actions bar (C295) where the pair has it: drawn while something is selected, fetched when first drawn.

relations.name: cl-tabs
$comment: The lane switcher on a phone (C304 (1)).

relations.name: cl-menu-context
$comment: The card menu and the lane menu (SF.menu.open).

relations.name: cl-avatar
$comment: Below: what the Framework field renderers draw in the «Кратко» place.

relations.name: align-items/default
$comment: The utility classes its templates write, asked for with the component (SIMAI Framework loader: a Framework component gets them from template-utilities.generated.json, a package component names them here); fetched after the first paint, they moved the drawn parts -- the bulk band's gap came 0 -> 8 and the band 8 px down some 150 ms in (View 1.8.1 acceptance, queue #172). The list is scripts/generate-template-utilities.mjs run over the overlay.

accessibility.x-keys: One Tab stop for the board (BD-10, C146 (8)): left and right go between lanes, up and down, Home and End inside a lane (its head's controls, its cards, «Показать ещё»); Space marks a card; Enter picks it up (sf-sortable) and the arrows carry it; Shift+F10 or the context menu key opens the card menu with «Переместить в»; Escape clears the selection. Every move is announced in the board's live region.

x-summary: The board layout of the view set: lanes by one field, cards with up to four fields in the «Кратко» place, a move is a change of that field the host settles. sf-view layout="board" draws it over the lane window.
x-decisions: shape: a leaf drawn by sf-view (layout board, the layout registry) or by a host directly; it owns no data.

reuse: sf-sortable for drag and keys, .sf-card, sf-badge, sf-checkbox, sf-button(-icon), sf-tabs (phone), sf-toast, SF.menu.open, the Framework field renderers' renderCellField; sf-bulk-actions where the pair has it. Nothing is copied.
window: one query answers the first per_lane records of every lane and the totals of all lanes; «Показать ещё» asks one lane further (C304, draft open point 1).

moves: a change of the lane field; the host's rules dim a lane while a card is held and disable it in «Переместить в»; a refusal puts the card back with the host's reason (toast and live region); limits are soft (C304 (3)); order follows the view's sort unless the source declares an order field and no sort is on (C304 (2)).
phone: one lane per screen under sf-tabs with counts, swipe kept (C304 (1)). Swimlanes: reserved (swimlane_field), not drawn (C304 (4)).

$comment: The board draws its lanes with sf-sortable, sf-badge and sf-button(-icon), its cards as .sf-card
with sf-checkbox and the Framework field renderers' cell output; menus, tabs and toasts come later.

lane.const: {value, label?, total, totals: {<field>: {<currency>: amount}}, records: [...], cursor}

untrusted_inputs: lane labels, titles and field values (drawn as text or by the field renderers)

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-view-board through sf-view layout="board" for records grouped by a status, choice, user or yes/no field, where a person moves them between lanes.
do_not: Do not save a move in the element; answer sf-view-board-move and call settleMove.
Do not use it for a calendar or a timeline.

accessibility.focus: A region named by aria-label (else «Канбан»); one Tab stop for the board, the arrows inside (lanes left and right, a lane's head, cards and «Показать ещё» up and down); a polite live region says every move and refusal; after a settled move focus stays on the card.

changes: New: the board layout (owner decisions C298, C304): lanes by one field from the host's lane window, cards with up to four fields in the «Кратко» place, moves as a change of the lane field the host settles (settleMove), «Показать ещё» per lane (appendLane), soft limits, folded and hidden lanes, one lane per screen on a phone, one Tab stop with the arrows inside.

Lane sums after the cards (view round 2 merge, agreed with Larena): sums-pending (set by sf-view while it asks the sums in a second request) holds the sum line of every lane head, so nothing grows when they come; setLaneTotals([{value, totals}]) merges the answered totals into the lanes without touching their cards or cursors.

The sums-pending description: sf-view asks the lane totals with the cards in one request (C304, VR2-9) and no longer sets it; the attribute and setLaneTotals stay for a page that computes the sums later.

DEV's open item B1 (round/view-r5): the column head's buttons (.sf-view-board__row, .sf-view-board__top) are --sf-space-1/3 apart (8; 4 compact), the gap of buttons of one group (H5), not --sf-space-1/4 (4).
View round 9 (round/view-r9): rule.js and component.json relations name cl-bulk-actions (lazy), composition.uses smart.bulk-actions; the pair's field-renderers provenance hash.
View round 12, set 3 (DEV msg-c31ccebd, VHF-10): js/templates/default.css .sf-view-board[data-size="1"] .sf-view-board__title, .sf-view-board__fields take --sf-text-size-1 and --sf-text-height-1.
View round 12, owner decision D2 (DEV msg-4de06ae6): lang title and board-label «Канбан» / «Kanban»; component.json and smart.manifest.json focus note.
